name: Textual (de-)calibrations definitions
purpose: The pas table holds the entries of the commanding textual (de-)calibrations declared in PAF, one record per alias/raw value pair. Each record associates a text string - the engineering interpretation shown to and typed by the operator - with the raw numerical value encoded in the command. When a command or sequence parameter with textual calibration (category T) is entered in engineering form, SCOS-2000 looks the text up in the alias set to obtain the raw value to encode; when a raw value is displayed, the alias text is shown. Raw values are always written in decimal and must match the raw format of the set (PAF_RAWFMT). The key (set name plus raw value) makes each raw value appear only once in a set. The text and value fields have no fixed length in ICD 7.0: their maximum length follows from the maximum command size. Aliases can also be used as default values of the parameters that reference the set (CPC_DEFVAL, CDF_VALUE, SDF_VALUE or CSP_DEFVAL written with an engineering representation).

fields.name: PAS_NUMBR
fields.description: Name (PAF_NUMBR) of the textual (de-)calibration to which this text/value pair belongs.

fields.name: PAS_ALTXT
fields.description: Text string giving the engineering interpretation of the raw value in PAS_ALVAL (the alias). Maximum length depends on the maximum command size.

fields.name: PAS_ALVAL
fields.description: Raw value, written in decimal, in a format compatible with PAF_RAWFMT of the set. Part of the key. Maximum length depends on the maximum command size.

history: ICD 5.1 (2001, section 3.3.3.6.4, PDF p.101-102): PAS_NUMBR Number(4), PAS_ALTXT Char(16), PAS_ALVAL Char(17), key PAS_NUMBR + PAS_ALVAL. ICD 6.7 Draft A (PDF p.196) and ICD 6.9 (PDF p.201): PAS_NUMBR Char(10), the other sizes unchanged. ICD 7.0 (PDF p.210): PAS_ALTXT and PAS_ALVAL without fixed size, bounded by the maximum command size (S2K-8073, PDF p.261). pyscos2000 (ICD 7.2) has the same three mandatory columns but marks all three, including PAS_ALTXT, as key.
notes: Key discrepancy: ICD 7.0 keys on PAS_NUMBR + PAS_ALVAL, pyscos2000 on all three columns. Solar Orbiter 2025-09-16: 11834 pairs (9741 in 2020) in 624 sets, all resolving to PAF; no set repeats a raw value or an alias text; the longest alias text is 16 characters, i.e. still within the Char(16) of earlier ICD issues, and the longest raw value 10 digits.
